tagline: One of the largest surface transportation, delivery, and logistics companies in North America.
hero_kpi_rationale: JBHT operates in the logistics and surface transportation sector. The operating margin of 7.2% in 2025 (versus 6.9% in 2024, representing a 4.1% increase) is the most relevant KPI as it reflects operational efficiency and the company's ability to generate profits from its core intermodal, dedicated services, capacity solutions, final mile, and truckload activities.
company_description: J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc. provides surface transportation, delivery, and logistic services in the United States. It operates through five segments: Intermodal, Dedicated Contract Services, Integrated Capacity Solutions, Final Mile Services, and Truckload. The JBI segment offers intermodal freight solutions. It operates 124,838 pieces of company-owned trailing equipment; owns and maintains its chassis fleet of 104,474 units; and manages a fleet of 5,880 company-owned tractors, 308 independent contractor trucks, and 8,704 company drivers. The DCS segment designs, develops, and executes supply chain solutions that support various transportation networks. As of December 31, 2025, it operated 11,878 company-owned trucks, 761 customer-owned trucks, and a contractor trucks. It operates 26,767 owned pieces of trailing equipment and 5,218 customer-owned trailers. The ICS segment provides freight brokerage and transportation logistics solutions; flatbed, refrigerated, expedited, and less-than-truckload, as well as dry-van and intermodal solutions; online multimodal marketplace; and logistics management services for customers to outsource their transportation functions. kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage of operating revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin indicates the company's ability to generate profits from its core transportation and logistics activities.
kpis.signal: Measures profitability of core operations before interest and taxes.

kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by all operating activities of the company.
kpis.description: Total operating revenues measure all revenues generated by the five business segments: intermodal, dedicated services, integrated capacity solutions, final mile services, and truckload.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of commercial performance and company size.

kpis.explanation: Net income after deduction of all expenses, taxes, and interest, expressed as a percentage of operating revenue.
kpis.description: Net earnings represent the company's final profit after all operating expenses, interest, and income taxes.
kpis.signal: Measures the company's final net profitability.

kpis.explanation: Ratio of operating expenses to operating revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: The operating ratio measures the percentage of revenue consumed by operating expenses. A lower ratio indicates better operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operational efficiency in the transportation industry.

kpis.explanation: Total expenses related to insurance and claims management, expressed as a percentage of operating revenue.
kpis.description: Insurance and claims expenses include insurance premiums for liability, property damage, vehicle accidents, and employee injury coverage.
kpis.signal: Reflects rising insurance costs and claims frequency.

kpis.explanation: Total expenses related to employee compensation and benefits, expressed as a percentage of operating revenue.
kpis.description: Salaries, wages, and benefits constitute the largest expense category after purchased transportation and represent labor costs.
kpis.signal: Major operating cost reflecting wage pressures and employee benefits.

risks.title: Dependence on a few large customers
risks.summary: The loss of one or more major customers could severely impact revenues and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned at the beginning of the 'Risks Related to Our Business' section and concerns the potential loss of customers representing 33% of revenue. The language emphasizes a 'material and adverse effect'. Customer dependence is stable vs. prior year. High weighting for the Competition category.

risks.title: Cyberattacks or system failure
risks.summary: An attack or IT failure could paralyze operations, compromise data, or delay deliveries.
risks.score_rationale: Positioned among the last risks but with strong language: 'material and adverse effect', mention of ransomware, data loss, and acknowledged prior incidents. Evolution of threats (AI, phishing). Cybersecurity category heavily weighted. Risk trending upward.

risks.title: Rising insurance and claims costs
risks.summary: Rising auto claims and insurance premiums directly weigh on profitability.
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights 'substantial increases' in liability costs, exceeding insurance layers. Repeated mention of impacts on results. Upward premium trend observed in 2025 (6.7% increase). Capital category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Rapid fuel cost fluctuations
risks.summary: Sudden fuel price increases can reduce margins while awaiting recovery through surcharges.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is moderate as it is offset by an automatic surcharge program. However, compensation delays and unrecovered costs (empty miles, idle time) are cited. No derivative hedging in 2025. Macro category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Driver and personnel shortage
risks.summary: Difficulty recruiting and retaining qualified personnel threatens growth and increases costs.
risks.score_rationale: Direct language: 'affect our profitability and growth'. Mention of wage pressures and dependence on third-party carriers. Structural risk in the industry. Industrial category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Reclassification of independent contractors
risks.summary: If independent contractors were reclassified as employees, it would result in massive payroll tax and social charge costs.
risks.score_rationale: Alarming language: 'material increase in costs', tax, social, and retroactive liabilities. Specific mention of California and stricter tests. Regulation category with high potential impact.

risks.title: Pandemics or global health crises
risks.summary: A pandemic could disrupt supply chains, reduce demand, and affect operations.
risks.score_rationale: Systemic risk cited with multiple effects: customer disruptions, shortages, port restrictions. Uncertain but concerned language ('significant effect'). Post-Covid context reinforces credibility. Geopolitical category moderately weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: JBHT does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report. Technology mentions are limited to cybersecurity and information systems. J.B. Hunt 360 is an online platform offering visibility and transparency in the supply chain, but without an explicit AI component.
